name: CoverLetterClassic

props.name: doc
props.desc: The tailored letter for one job, from @/features/jobs/lib/documents. Absent: the fictional DEMO_COVER_LETTER.

props.name: page
props.desc: The paper: US Letter (default) or A4.

whenUse: A job application needs its cover letter as a business letter that matches ResumeClassic — same header rule, type and accent.
whenNot: A resume — use ResumeClassic. In-app prose — use the shared/ui typography primitives.

tests.name: CoverLetterClassic — a business letter from the content alone, in reading order
